title: Seymour River FSR 7271.01 (September 15, 2025)
source_text: Seymour River FSR 7271.01 (September 15, 2025): Road is washed-out at 45 km, this includes bridge K1066. Crews are currently assessing the road washout. There is no vehicle access beyond this point. Message is intended for wide distribution. There is no timeline on a reopening for this road.
